key_notes: Key 1 (t=0.8s): Initial archival pose of squirrel; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=1.93s): Mid-sequence articulation of squirrel; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=3.16s): Peak dynamic extension of squirrel over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=4.4s): Follow-through and settle of squirrel with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of squirrel (0.8s..4.4s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
